thread:
IncidentBot: P0 alert: elevated 5xx rate and routing churn across us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. auto-page to #incidents. link: https://internal.redwood/alerts/4223456789 :rotating_light:
Alex P: acked. I'm oncall. seeing ~12% 5xx for gen API and a spike in 502s around 4223456700. pulling logs now.
Priya S: I can help with routing/debug traces. Paging in case it's policy-related.
Carlos M: Noted customer-reported latency from EU customers. Customer success flagged 3 enterprise tenants seeing failed requests.
Alex P: quick check -> telemetry shows healthchecks flapping for node pools in eu. probe shows repeated health toggles causing requests to bounce. suspect routing fallback policy loop.
Jamie L: any recent deploys to routing/policy?
Alex P: looking at audit -> routing-policy service had a config push ~4223456600 by automation for 'variant-priorities' rollout.
IncidentBot: config-change detected: routing-policies/rollout-variant-priorities v3 by infra-robot at 4223456602.
Priya S: digging into the policy: it looks like eu fallback tier accidentally lists 'model-x-legacy-8bit' as compatible fallback for our newest 'model-x-16gb' family. Variant mismatch -> inference fails health probe (proto mismatch) and returns 5xx, router sees node unhealthy, falls back to next region, hits same incompatible variant there, bounce.
Alex P: that matches the stack traces: "ModelVariantError: KV cache format incompatible" in eu nodes.
Carlos M: customers seeing ~3x latency and some rate-limited retries. Impact window estimate so far: 7m and ongoing.
Jamie L: we need a stopgap: disable cross-region automatic fallback for the gen API route, force prefer-us-east only for active requests. I'll take mitigation if Alex wants to hand off.
oncall-sre: alex, please escalate to secondary if handing off.
Alex P: handing to Jamie. I'm shifting to observer. Jamie, go ahead.
Jamie L: taking. Executing emergency policy toggle. Command: 
```
redwood-cli routing set-policy --route /v1/generate --primary-region us-east --allow-cross-region-fallback false --reason "emergency stopgap: variant mismatch causing ping-pong"
```
Jamie L: applied at 4223456760. IncidentBot: policy-change recorded.
IncidentBot: Health probes: eu nodes still flapping but traffic no longer being rerouted across regions for gen route.
Priya S: confirming on traces: failures drop by ~80% after policy toggle, retry loop stops. Queues drain.
Alex P: good. next we should roll back the variant-priority change and quarantine the bad mapping. Priya, can you patch the policy to remove model-x-legacy-8bit as fallback and mark as incompatible?
Priya S: on it. Patch snippet: 
```
{"route":"/v1/generate","fallbacks": ["model-x-16gb-v2","model-x-16gb-v1"], "deprecated_fallbacks": ["model-x-legacy-8bit"]}
```
Priya S: patch applied at 4223456798 and activated.
Jamie L: rolling restart of affected eu pool to clear bad cache entries. Command: `kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-eu --namespace redwood-inference` -> started at 4223456805.
Carlos M: notifying CS and impacted customers with a brief note: "We've mitigated cross-region routing and are patching fallback mapping. Expect normalization within 10-15m; we'll follow up with detailed RCA."
Alex P: good communication. Can we quantify requests failed? Telemetry -> ~4.3k failed requests total, ~2.8k attributable to fallback loop, ~600 requests retried successfully, 70 customers saw at least one 5xx.
IncidentBot: Pager notification: next oncall rotation -> Priya S in 5m for handoff.
Alex P: handing final operational duties to Priya for sweep and postmortem. Priya, please collect logs and timestamps and start an RCA doc. Assign action items: (1) revert automated rollout validation to require variant compatibility checks; (2) add a circuit-breaker to avoid cross-region fallthrough when healthcheck failure rate > 5% per minute; (3) customer follow-up.
Priya S: acknowledged. I'll start the RCA doc and set owners. Initial timeline in doc: https://internal.redwood/rca/4223456789
Jamie L: I'll follow up to re-enable safe cross-region fallback once we have signed-off compatibility tests.
Carlos M: CS updated customers. No major data loss reported.
Alex P: postmortem owners: Priya (RCA), Jamie (mitigation followups), Carlos (customer comms). Target: postmortem draft in 48h.
Priya S: adding runbook improvement: add a preflight that validates model artifact schema before marking variant as compatible.
IncidentBot: incident status -> mitigated. Reduced error rate and routing churn. Keep thread open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Alex P: thanks team. I'll close my watch; reach out in thread for anything urgent.
Jamie L: leaving monitoring to Priya and SRE.
Priya S: will keep an eye for 30m and then update status.
Carlos M: thanks all.
(End of thread)
